Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/gallery (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. change.x-summary: The shown slide changed: by a person in the inline view or the lightbox, or by an action (from api)

open.x-summary: Opens the lightbox, at index when given; refused (no-lightbox) without a lightbox
open.summary: Moves to the given one-based slide when an index is passed, sets open and opens the lightbox modal. Returns the element.

close.x-summary: Closes the lightbox; refused (closed) when it is closed
close.summary: Removes open and closes the lightbox modal. Returns the element.

toggle.summary: Calls close() when open, open(index) otherwise. Returns the element.

go-to.x-summary: Shows the slide at index (1-based, clamped to the slides)
go-to.summary: Moves to a one-based slide, clamped to the slide count, reflects it to the current attribute, syncs both sliders and dispatches sf-change when it moved. Returns the element.

next.summary: goTo(current + 1); stops at the last slide. Returns the element.

prev.summary: goTo(current - 1); stops at the first slide. Returns the element.

slide.$comment: Each child of the host is a slide; the gallery places it in its inline slider and its lightbox (§4.5).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The root has no role of its own: the inline view is sf-slider (its slides and arrows named by Swiper's a11y module) and the lightbox is sf-modal, a dialog named by heading that traps focus and closes on Escape. Enter and Space on a [data-sf-gallery-open] trigger open the lightbox.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-gallery for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

x-summary: An ordered media collection shown in an inline Slider, with an optional Modal lightbox holding a second Slider. The gallery owns the one-based current slide and keeps both views on it.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
settings.blur → backdrop-blur: "blur" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
events.change: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-change → change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.close: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-close → close (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.open: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-open → open (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
settings.button-size: type string with the numeral default "1" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.dots-size: type string with the numeral default "2" → number (§16 item 29)

events.open → opened and close → closed: they are sent after the lightbox opened or closed, so they are facts and take the past form (§8, vocabulary §4); the DOM names are sf-gallery-opened and sf-gallery-closed
methods.getModal, getInlineSlider, getLightboxSlider: readers retire (§4.4), kept and noted until the date
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: title, blur, sf-change, sf-open, sf-close and the three readers are dated rows, the actions answer outcomes; a minor while the rows hold (§4.10).

events: change {previous, current, total, from} keeps the DOM name change (§8); the lightbox's facts are opened and closed {current, total} (sf-gallery-opened, -closed), sent after the modal opened or closed, so the past form. sf-change, sf-open and sf-close follow with the same detail until 2026-12-01; component, tagName and template leave the detail (§8). A nested slider's change stops at the gallery, which reports it as its own change.
a11y-role: none on the root. The inline view is sf-slider; the lightbox is sf-modal (role dialog, named by heading, traps focus, Escape closes when close-on-esc).
key-effects: Enter and Space on a [data-sf-gallery-open] trigger open the lightbox (open); Tab reaches the slider's and the modal's controls.
number-type: button-size and dots-size are steps of the size ladder (1/2, 1, 2) handed to sf-slider, not numbers; they stay strings. current is an integer from 1.
words: the lightbox's heading was the English «Gallery» on every page; it is the language file's word now (heading default-from runtime.heading: «Галерея», «Gallery»).

lightbox: the template hands sf-modal its own names, heading and backdrop-blur, so the modal's dated aliases are not used by the Framework itself; a trigger's data-sf-modal-title and data-sf-modal-blur keep configuring the delegated lightbox.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js and styles its sheet js/templates/default.css, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the lightbox and the actions; probe.json drives go-to, next, open, close and the aliases.
skeleton: none; the slides are the page's children, drawn before any code; the lightbox is closed at first paint (§5.4).
css-variables: five public variables read by the gallery's own sheet; the slider's and the modal's pass through (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate). The slide attributes are printed in the order the element sets them.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-gallery for one ordered media collection with one-based current state, an inline Slider and optional Modal lightbox. Nested Sliders inherit token-driven spacing, reduced-motion behavior, autoplay pause and hidden-slide focus protection unless the author supplies explicit compatibility overrides.
do_not: The rendered Gallery root permits shrinking in grid/flex via min-width:0. Do not hide document overflow or reset Slider instances to compensate for parent intrinsic sizing; explicit author widths remain the author's responsive-layout responsibility.

current/open-only updates preserve the existing inline Slider and use updateMode:dom. Observe sf-updated for these state changes, not sf-after-render. Actual configuration and slot changes still render; do not recreate unchanged slide content just to open Modal.

Load the Gallery composition CSS declared by cl-gallery. Do not overwrite projected figure/image/caption inline styles. Reuse Slider dimension/fit tokens, --sf-gallery-media--max-height and Modal scrolling for long content; width/height/fullscreen remain Modal options.

Gallery owns the selected position across inline/lightbox rendering. Use its one-based current/goTo/open API; do not maintain a second current index on nested Sliders or repair their position with delayed callbacks.

Slide counts and inline/lightbox indices use meaningful slot items, excluding formatting whitespace and comments. Keep composite cards inside one attributed root or one child of a bare slot container; do not treat each sibling heading or link as part of an inferred card.
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

sf-change.summary: The current slide changed through the API or either slider. Bubbles and is composed.

sf-close.summary: The lightbox modal finished closing. Bubbles and is composed.

sf-open.summary: The lightbox modal finished opening. Bubbles and is composed.

getModal.summary: Returns the lightbox sf-modal, or null when there is none.

getInlineSlider.summary: Returns the inline sf-slider, or null before render.

getLightboxSlider.summary: Returns the lightbox sf-slider, or null when there is none.
